name: kg_update_node_field
description: Narrow per-field edit on a KG node. Allowed scalar fields: category, description, original_sentence, valid_during, start_date, end_date, start_date_prose, end_date_prose, start_date_confidence, end_date_confidence, importance, goal_status, semantic_label. Allowed list fields: aliases, hash_tags (use list_op = 'add' / 'remove' / 'set'). Atomic. Reversible via kg_revision_log. For label changes use kg_rename_label; for merging use kg_merge_nodes. Always pass a non-empty `reason`. Pass `dry_run: true` to preview.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: New value. For list fields, may be a string or list.

inputs.name: list_op
inputs.description: For aliases/hash_tags: add | remove | set. Default set.

outputs.description: {ok, revision_log_id, field, old_value, new_value} on commit; {ok, dry_run, before, after} on dry_run.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for kg_update_node_field:
- node_id (required)
- field (required): scalar (description, category, ...) or list (aliases, hash_tags)
- value (required)
- list_op (optional, list fields only): add | remove | set
- reason (required)
- dry_run (optional)
- finding_id (optional)
